dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We've been to so many places lately! What do you say we take a day off from adventuring and just find somewhere nice to relax?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let Paimon think, where are some nice places we could go... Oh, why don't we pay Cloud Retainer a visit at Mt. Aocang?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last saw that illuminated bird! She's always the one popping up out of nowhere and scaring us half to death, so let's surprise her this time!
